text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's so bright outside. It must be morning

already...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe I fell asleep. I'd best get
ready. I'll
just take care of any
unfinished calculations with
the rest of
my homework tonight—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Sigh... How unsightly of me. I knew I should have gone to sleep earlier... Well, it's too late now.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'd better keep it together in front of
Trainer.

Too absorbed in her thoughts, Biwa
Hayahide
hasn't gotten a good night's
rest.
